verdict.rationale: Trello's docs mention a mobile-specific capability ('Scan text with your camera on mobile'), and a hands-on community report confirms an iPhone app exists. That same report says the iPhone app is 'very far from their web interface' and 'an order of magnitude less usable' than the web app, needing 6-7 clicks to reach a checklist, which contradicts the 'without missing desktop functionality' part of the story. Vendor docs never claim feature parity, and an older report noted no Android app. Missing for 10: documented native iOS/Android apps, evidence of feature parity with desktop/web, current independent corroboration of mobile completeness.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
